name: s2b_xtb
purpose: S2b registration ('Computation': GFN2-xTB force fields of the new molecules on the laptop, amendment 4's input): xtb-binary minima from each molecule's G minimum (probes/fetch_g_minima.sh from s2b1–s2b3), dxtb Hessians by force differences, dpir.qff; relaunched with a longer list as the servers' molecules reach their G reference (xtb_anharmonic.sh skips finished molecules)

estimate.basis: S2 amendment 4's xtb fields on this laptop: ±1–3 h per molecule of 9–21 atoms (s2_xtb, 18 Oct); up to 23 molecules, run as they arrive

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run's process tree at 1536 MB (MemoryMax, tested 19 Oct), as s2_xtb
